notes: Step 1 parts are unchanged: one board, one breadboard, one LED, one 220 ohm resistor, and two jumper wires.
Circuit as drawn: pin 2 -> green wire -> breadboard column 3 -> 220 ohm resistor -> column 6 -> LED anode. The LED cathode (column 8) -> black wire -> GND next to AREF.
The image shows the LED's bent, longer leg in column 6, so I took that as the anode. The straight leg in column 8 is the cathode and goes to GND.

The catalogue's breadboard names the upper half as bank 't' (rows a-e). The image labels that half f-j, so I used 't' holes. Each column's five holes are one strip, so the exact row letters don't change the circuit.
The UNO WiFi Rev2 was not found by lookup_part, so it is a new part type with Uno-style header ports. The GND next to AREF is mapped to GND.1.
The sketch also reads A1 (analogRead) as a 'random reading', but the diagram has nothing on A1, so I added no connection there.
